changelog: mariowOS 2 is our biggest release so far. A new design made for mariowOS with its own icons and light and dark themes. Updates and Store apps no longer need Git, and a new Windows installer needs nothing else. Global search (Win+S) finds apps, files and settings and does calculations. Widgets (Win+W) show the clock, weather, today's events, notes and music. Notifications are grouped by app with Do not disturb per app. Apps get a real SDK with permissions you approve at install, and the Store adds categories, featured apps, developer pages and a My apps page to review permissions. Optional anonymous usage count, off by default.
